title: 卡里巴水壩
summary: 本課以由卡里巴修復工程連結拱壩水墊沖蝕與閘門界面為主線，先用拱作用與壩肩傳力與水位荷載與非線性界定水力與構造條件，再將節理壓差與拔出、圍堰抽排與水量連結到修復效益與同工況。本課模型只是修復議題的機制示意，未重建卡里巴設計；舊工程頁的預定完工年不當實際完工事實。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops connecting Kariba rehabilitation with arch action plunge-pool scour and gate interfaces through Arch action and abutment transfer and Reservoir load and nonlinear response, then connects Joint pressure and block removal and Cofferdam dewatering balance to Rehabilitation benefit and matched states. Models illustrate rehabilitation mechanisms without reconstructing Kariba design; old scheduled completion dates are not treated as achieved milestones. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拱作用與壩肩傳力」與「水位荷載與非線性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arch action and abutment transfer" and "Reservoir load and nonlinear response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch action and abutment transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱作用與壩肩傳力」如何影響卡里巴水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch action and abutment transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kariba Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 卡里巴的拱壩背景要求理解水壓如何經曲率傳向壩肩，水平薄環近似只處理一部分受力。實際壩同時具有懸臂、接縫與地基相互作用，不能把一條薄拱環代表全壩；壩肩剛度與節理會改變拱向力分配。 驗證時應以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設，並辨識以下失效情境：壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱作用與壩肩傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Kariba provides context for pressure transfer through curvature toward abutments. A thin horizontal ring represents only one component of response. Real behavior includes cantilever action, joints and foundation interaction; one ring cannot stand for the whole dam, and abutment stiffness changes the load distribution. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch action and abutment transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一條薄環公式就能代表整座拱壩全部應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One thin-ring equation represents every stress in an arch dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱作用與壩肩傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch action and abutment transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力
knowledge.text: 卡里巴的拱壩背景要求理解水壓如何經曲率傳向壩肩，水平薄環近似只處理一部分受力。實際壩同時具有懸臂、接縫與地基相互作用，不能把一條薄拱環代表全壩；壩肩剛度與節理會改變拱向力分配。
knowledge.textEn: Kariba provides context for pressure transfer through curvature toward abutments. A thin horizontal ring represents only one component of response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一條薄環公式就能代表整座拱壩全部應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One thin-ring equation represents every stress in an arch dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱作用與壩肩傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch action and abutment transfer" is correct?
options: 一條薄環公式就能代表整座拱壩全部應力
卡里巴的拱壩背景要求理解水壓如何經曲率傳向壩肩，水平薄環近似只處理一部分受力。
水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: One thin-ring equation represents every stress in an arch dam
Kariba provides context for pressure transfer through curvature toward abutments.
A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent
quiz.explanation: 卡里巴的拱壩背景要求理解水壓如何經曲率傳向壩肩，水平薄環近似只處理一部分受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Kariba provides context for pressure transfer through curvature toward abutments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch action and abutment transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱作用與壩肩傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch action and abutment transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱作用與壩肩傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch action and abutment transfer", which statement holds?
options: 水墊體積增加就保證所有局部脈壓同比下降
最大沖深不變就表示沖坑完全沒有不利變化
原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。
optionsEn: A larger pool guarantees a proportional reduction in every local pressure pulse
Unchanged maximum depth proves that no adverse scour change has occurred
Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch action and abutment transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱作用與壩肩傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch action and abutment transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱作用與壩肩傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch action and abutment transfer"?
options: 以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
某一開度運轉正常就證明整個行程都不會卡阻
optionsEn: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal operation at one opening proves the gate cannot bind anywhere
quiz.explanation: 以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arch action and abutment transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱作用與壩肩傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch action and abutment transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。診斷時應採取以下查核：以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一條薄環公式就能代表整座拱壩全部應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One thin-ring equation represents every stress in an arch dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。診斷時應採取以下查核：以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱作用與壩肩傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arch action and abutment transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。
水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution.
A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent
quiz.explanation: 壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水位荷載與非線性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reservoir load and nonlinear response: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位荷載與非線性」如何影響卡里巴水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reservoir load and nonlinear response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kariba Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位變化同時改變受壓高度與壓力大小，合力因此不與水深線性成長。用矩形投影估水平靜水力可說明尺度，拱壩實際位移還受溫度及接縫開合影響；監測比較必須分離水位與季節效應。 驗證時應以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應，並辨識以下失效情境：把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位荷載與非線性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stage changes both loaded height and pressure, so resultant force does not grow linearly with depth. A projected rectangular surface illustrates horizontal loading, while actual arch displacement also depends on temperature and joint opening. Monitoring comparisons must separate stage and seasonal effects. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reservoir load and nonlinear response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reservoir load and nonlinear response”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位荷載與非線性
knowledge.text: 水位變化同時改變受壓高度與壓力大小，合力因此不與水深線性成長。用矩形投影估水平靜水力可說明尺度，拱壩實際位移還受溫度及接縫開合影響；監測比較必須分離水位與季節效應。
knowledge.textEn: Stage changes both loaded height and pressure, so resultant force does not grow linearly with depth. A projected rectangular surface illustrates horizontal loading, while actual arch displacement also depends on temperature and joint opening.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位荷載與非線性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reservoir load and nonlinear response" is correct?
options: 水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成
總流量相同就保證水墊內全部壓力相同
水位變化同時改變受壓高度與壓力大小，合力因此不與水深線性成長。
optionsEn: A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent
Equal total discharge guarantees identical pressures throughout the pool
Stage changes both loaded height and pressure, so resultant force does not grow linearly with depth.
quiz.explanation: 水位變化同時改變受壓高度與壓力大小，合力因此不與水深線性成長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stage changes both loaded height and pressure, so resultant force does not grow linearly with depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位荷載與非線性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reservoir load and nonlinear response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位荷載與非線性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reservoir load and nonlinear response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水位荷載與非線性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reservoir load and nonlinear response", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width。
完整岩石強度高就不需檢查節理壓差
抽水能力越大就保證圍堰施工越安全

High intact strength removes the need to check pressure across joints
Greater pumping capacity always makes cofferdam work safer
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水位荷載與非線性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir load and nonlinear response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位荷載與非線性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reservoir load and nonlinear response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水位荷載與非線性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reservoir load and nonlinear response"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應。
平常低壓差就代表隔水構件永遠只受小荷載
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response.
Normally low differential pressure means isolation components always carry small loads
quiz.explanation: 以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水位荷載與非線性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reservoir load and nonlinear response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位荷載與非線性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reservoir load and nonlinear response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。診斷時應採取以下查核：以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水深增加一成靜水合力也必定只增加一成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten-percent depth increase always raises hydrostatic force only ten percent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。診斷時應採取以下查核：以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水位荷載與非線性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reservoir load and nonlinear response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總流量相同就保證水墊內全部壓力相同
把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal total discharge guarantees identical pressures throughout the pool
Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
